specification.exposure_requirement: later exposure_pitcher strictly exceeds earlier exposure_pitcher
specification.distance: Euclidean covariate distance divided by fixed coordinate tolerances; no data-estimated scales
specification.matching: Greedy chronological; closest eligible unmatched earlier swing; ties choose most recent; no replacement
specification.outcome_eligibility: None; outcome values and missingness never enter matching
specification.contrast: later minus earlier; negative means a decline; not divided by exposure increment
specification.uncertainty: 2000 game-cluster bootstrap replicates within each season; paired swings kept together
specification.scope: Descriptive matched restriction among tracked swings; not causal identification
